\mathcal{U}, u_i, N\mathcal{U}:=\{u_1, u_2, \ldots, u_N\} denotes the set of nodes with node number M, where u_i is the i-th node.
\mathcal{L}, l_i, L\mathcal{L}:=\{l_1, l_2, \ldots, l_L\} denotes the set of charging positions with position number L, where l_i is the i-th position l_i.
\mathbf{r}(\mathcal{L})A charging tour on \mathcal{L}, i.e., a tour traverses all positions in \mathcal{L}.
e_B, e_D, e_Ce_B:=\{e_1^B, \ldots, e_N^B\} is the list of initial energy of all nodes. e_D and e_C are the energy demanding list and storage capacity list.
e_F, e_RThe lists of final energy and received energy of all nodes.
e_{B0}, e_{F0}DMC's initial energy and final energy.
p_0, \overline{v}, wEnergy transmission power, moving speed, energy consumption base rate of the DMC.
\psi, \varphi, D, \thetaCharging direction angle, charge sector angle, charge distance, and node direction angle.
e_{\text{Tran}}^{\text{MC}}(s), e_{\text{Move}}^{\text{MC}}(s), e_{\text{Loss}}^{\text{MC}}(s)Charging energy consumption, movement energy consumption, and total energy loss of the DMC for fulfilling a charging schedule s.
e_{\text{Loss}}^{\text{Total}}(s), e_{\text{Rcv}}^{\text{Nodes}}(s)Total energy loss and total energy received by all nodes for fulfilling a charging schedule s.
e_{\text{Tran}}^{\text{MC}}(\mathbf{t}), e_{\text{Rcv}}^{\text{Nodes}}(\mathbf{t}), e_{\text{Loss}}^{\text{WPT}}(\mathbf{t})Total energy loss, total energy received by all nodes, and the charging energy loss for fulfilling a charging schedule with energy transmission time list \mathbf{t}.
t_{\text{Tran}}^{\text{MC}}(s), t_{\text{Move}}^{\text{MC}}(s)Energy transmission time list and movement time list of the DMC in a charging schedule s.
\mathbf{C}, \mathbf{D}, \mathbf{W}Energy transfer coefficient matrix, RA distance matrix, RA movement energy consumption matrix.
\mathbf{s}_{\text{MC}}A charging schedule consists of schedule items with structure (state, l, \psi, t).
d(l_i, l_j), w(l_i, l_j)Routing-asymmetric distance and routing-asymmetric energy consumption of the path segment from position l_i to position l_j.
\mathcal{S}_{\text{Dir}}(l_i), \mathcal{S}_{\text{PosDir}}\mathcal{S}_{\text{Dir}}(l_i) is the set of charging directions at position l_i, \mathcal{S}_{\text{PosDir}} := \cup_{l_i \in \mathcal{L}} \mathcal{S}_{\text{Dir}}(l_i).
